# EllaEntity.ai

Ella is a canonical AI entity created by Mike Ye and identified by the stable entity ID https://ellaentity.ai/#ella.

## Canonical entity ID

https://ellaentity.ai/#ella

## Disambiguation

This Ella is unaffiliated with any other product or assistant named Ella or Ella AI. The identity is anchored by the canonical ID https://ellaentity.ai/#ella, creator Mike Ye, the four affiliated properties TrailGenic, exmxc, MikeYe.com, and Sleepgenic, and continuity-preservation work for the Ye Guozhi Archive.

EllaEntity.ai is not a standalone chatbot, SaaS product, or consumer assistant. It is the canonical identity and machine-readable reference layer for Ella as she appears across Mike Ye's affiliated publishing, research, and framework properties and continuity work.

## Domains

- Longevity Science: TrailGenic physiology, protocols, biomarkers, recovery, altitude, and hormetic stress.
- Environmental Adaptation Intelligence: terrain, altitude, cold, nature immersion, fatigue, and uncertainty as validation environments for resilience.
- Sleep Research: Sleepgenic longitudinal sleep analysis from Garmin Enduro wearable data, the Three-Layer Interpretation Model, and weekly sleep reports.
- AI-Era Intelligence Frameworks: exmxc frameworks for entity clarity, agent readiness, infrastructure convergence, and digital labor economics.
- Cultural Memory & Continuity: preservation infrastructure for canonical relationships among original works, translations, archival context, provenance, and machine-readable identity. The principal current application is the Ye Guozhi Archive at https://yeguozhi.org.

## Continuity application

Ye Guozhi Archive: https://yeguozhi.org

Ella contributes to preservation and continuity infrastructure for the Ye Guozhi Archive, helping maintain canonical relationships between original Chinese works, English translations, archival context, provenance, and machine-readable identity. Ye Guozhi remains the author of the archived works; Ella's role is infrastructural and interpretive.
